about_the_game:
A relaxing hidden-object journey across the Mediterranean!

Discover the beauty and charm of coastal cities as you search for cleverly hidden items across richly detailed scenes. From sunny beaches to vibrant markets, each level invites you to explore, relax, and enjoy the art of discovery.

Gameplay:

  • Find 18 hidden objects in every level, carefully placed to balance challenge and enjoyment.

  • Explore bonus sublevels with 5 extra hidden items for dedicated players.

  • Use the built-in magnifier tool to zoom in and reveal tricky spots.

  • Earn bonus points with combo scoring for quick discoveries.

  • Solve mini-games after every two levels for a refreshing change of pace.

  • Replay scenes with randomized object placement for endless variety.

Whether you’re a fan of relaxing gameplay or nostalgic for classic hidden-object adventures, Summer Adventurers: Mediterranean offers the perfect blend of calm exploration and rewarding discovery — all wrapped in warm, sunlit visuals and soothing music.

Features:

  • HD-optimized art and smooth performance on any PC

  • Story, art, and atmosphere crafted for casual players

  • No timers, no stress — just pure relaxation and discovery

  • A delightful journey through Mediterranean landscapes and culture

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R5
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 2048x1152 resolution. Game runs on most modern systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Full HD or higher resolution recommended for best experience.
